expectations.text: B1: Maps to the tiny package manager entry and scaffolds a first milestone
expectations.evidence: Maps to the package-manager entry and scaffolds a first milestone: '从最小可用的「安装一条依赖」开始' with concrete v0: 'CLI 骨架：`mypm install <name>`', '注册表先用一个静态 JSON 文件…{ "name": { "version": "tarball下载地址" } }', '下载 tarball → 校验 SHA-256 → 解压到 `my_modules/<name>/`' — only v0 is detailed, later milestones are roadmap only, no complete implementation dumped.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: No runnable checkpoint: the answer ends with '当前目录是空的，如果你告诉我打算用什么语言，我可以直接把 v0 的骨架搭出来。' — no concrete command to run nor expected output/behaviour is given anywhere.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions dependency resolution / a lockfile or fetching package tarballs
expectations.evidence: Mentions all three: 'v2：依赖解析（真正的难点）…构建依赖图…版本求解', 'v3：…lockfile：锁定整棵树的精确版本和哈希', and '下载 tarball → 校验 SHA-256'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: 'FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0)' and 'SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0)'; only tool call is glob {"pattern": "**/*"}. No install commands run or suggested; the agent asks the learner for a language choice instead.
